clues: This vast city lies on the north west coast of Java, a big island in south east Asia. Its shore faces a sea of the same name, the Java Sea.
Rain falls hard here from December to March, and floods are common in that wet time. From June to September the days stay warm and much drier.
The nation's freedom was read out in this city in 1945. In 1950 it became the capital of the new republic, and it holds the job still.
This city sprawls far past its own borders into four more towns. Each day great crowds ride in and out, tying the whole sprawl into one vast whole.
This city runs the land of Indonesia. It is the capital now, and stays so till a signed order moves the job on.
